entry.title: Café Meherban
entry.hook: You get ₹600 for the month. Can you make it last and still save for something you want?
entry.boss: The month is the boss. Bills, temptations and one big surprise are coming.
entry.objective: You'll learn to save first, notice small spends, keep money for emergencies, and spot costly loans.
entry.note: All amounts are made up, for practice.
entry.privacy: We only save your game choices, not who you are.

hud.fictional: Quick Cash is a made-up app, not a real company.
hud.rotate: Turn your phone sideways to play
hud.rotateSub: The café needs the wide view.

src.question: Pay ₹{{x}} from which jar?
src.emergency: Your backup money. Something may still come.

goals.reactEarphones: Earphones! Nice. Long bus rides will be better.
goals.reactTrip: A trip with friends. Great choice.

r0.l1: It's the 1st of the month. You walk into Café Meherban.
r0.l2: Arre, come in! Sit, sit. Have some chai.
r0.l3: There's an envelope on the table. ₹600 and a note.
r0.note: Here's your money for the month. Listen to Chacha. Love, Ammamma
r0.l5: ₹600 for the whole month. Let's see how you use it.
r0.l6: This month will test you. I'll be right here to help.
r0.l7: First, what are you saving for?
r0.l8: So your goal is ₹250. Try to save that by month end.
r0.l9: Quick guess before we start. There's no wrong answer.
r0.predict: How many surprise expenses will you get this month?
r0.rTwo: Two or more? Ready for anything, I see.
r0.after: Okay! Now let's sort your money.
r0.give: Before you sit. This came for you. From Ammamma.

r1.l1: Smart people decide where money goes before spending it.
r1.l2: You have three jars. Spend is for daily things.
r1.l3: Save is for your goal. Try not to touch it.
r1.l4: Emergency is backup money for surprises.
r1.l5: See that cloud outside? Something's coming. Nobody knows what.
r1.l6: Three bills are coming this month. You'll have to pay them.
r1.hint: Drag coins into the jars, or tap +. Put all ₹600 somewhere.
r1.saveZero: Nothing saved? That's risky for your goal.
r1.saveFull: Your whole goal saved first. Now live on the rest.
r1.spendBig: Lots for spending. Let's see if it lasts.
r1.emergencyZero: No emergency money. Hope nothing goes wrong.
r1.emergencySmall: A little for emergencies. Good start.
r1.balanced: A bit in each jar. Nice balance.
r1.allSave: Everything saved? How will you get to class?
r1.mind: Okay! The month begins. Watch out for temptations.

bill.chachaAuto: A bill. You have to pay this one.
bill.chachaData: Recharge time. Bills can't be skipped.
bill.chachaLunch: Exam day lunch. This is a need.
bill.fromSave: Paid from Save, so your goal went down.

window.hint: Not sure? Tap Wait. Wants often fade if you wait.
window.short: Not enough in Spend. You could use Save.
window.dynRow: That's a lot of shopping in a row.
window.dynDrop: Waited and didn't need them. Money saved!
window.fizzing: The orange bottle is almost bursting.
window.summary: You saw {{n}} things. Bought {{g}}. Waited on {{m}}. Spend jar: ₹{{x}}.

gamepack.name: Game pack
gamepack.pitch: New game pack! Only ₹50! All your friends have it!
gamepack.get: Bought it! Hope you play it a lot.
gamepack.coolYes: You still wanted it. Fair enough.
gamepack.coolNo: You didn't really need it. Nice.

jacket.name: Jacket
jacket.pitch: Sale ends today! Jacket for ₹200! Last one!
jacket.get: A jacket? It's still hot in Hyderabad!
jacket.pass: He'll be back tomorrow with the same sale.

match.name: Match ticket
match.pitch: Cricket match tonight! Few tickets left!
match.soldOut: Sold out while you waited. Sometimes that happens.
match.soldOutNo: Sold out. You're fine with it.

cover.name: Phone cover
cover.coolYes: Thought about it and bought it. Smart.
cover.coolNo: No cover. Hope you don't drop your phone.

trolley.l1: Here comes Yusuf with his snack cart. Small things, cheap prices.
trolley.noSaucer: Small buys don't feel like much.
trolley.end: That's all the snacks. Quick question.
trolley.predict: How much do you think you spent on snacks?
trolley.above: You guessed {{range}}. It was ₹{{x}}! Small things add up.
trolley.inside: You guessed {{range}}. It was ₹{{x}}. Spot on!
trolley.below: You guessed {{range}}. Only ₹{{x}}. Less than you thought!
trolley.nothing: No snacks at all? ₹0 spent. Impressive.
trolley.worth1: Spending is okay. Just know what you spend on.
trolley.worthMeh: ₹{{y}} went on things you didn't love. That could have gone to your goal.
trolley.worthAllGlad: You liked everything you bought. That's good spending.

bn.title: Big Night
bn.refused2: You said no to {{a}} and {{b}}. All those no's add up.
bn.refused1: You said no to {{a}}. The no's are adding up.
bn.inviteFun: Cricket final on the big screen tonight! ₹{{x}} each. Everyone's coming. You in?
bn.inviteFriends: Ayesha's birthday dinner tonight! ₹{{x}} each. Everyone's coming. You in?
bn.chacha: Saying no to everything is hard. Sometimes a small treat helps. Your choice.
bn.hint: No right answer. Pick what feels right.
bn.goSub: Pay from any jar. The bottle calms down.
bn.halfSub: Pay from any jar. The bottle calms a little.
bn.staySub: Free. But the bottle stays full and gets worse next month.
bn.rHalf: You went for a while and came home early.
bn.rStay: You stayed home. Money saved, but you still want to go.
bn.carried: You skipped last time, so you want it even more now.

teja.l1: Hey! Match on Saturday, ₹100 a ticket. I'm ₹100 short!
teja.l1kit: Hey! My project kit is due Monday. ₹100. I'm ₹100 short!
teja.l2: Can you lend me ₹100? I'll pay you back Friday, promise!
teja.aside: People say 'Friday' a lot. Fridays don't always happen.
teja.rule: Only lend what you can live without for a while.
teja.sub_gift30: ₹30 from Spend. No need to return.
teja.sub_no: No money. You say: 'Can't this month, next chai's on me.'
teja.you_no: Can't this month, yaar. Next chai's on me.
teja.t_gift30: Arre, really? Thank you! I owe you a chai.
teja.t_no: No problem! Next chai's yours then.
teja.c_lend100: ₹100 is with Teja now. You can't use it till it comes back.
teja.c_lend50: Lending less is okay. Good thinking.
teja.c_gift30: A gift is simple. No waiting for it back.
teja.c_no: A real friend understands a kind no.
teja.honest: You can't lend money you don't have.
teja.thunder: Thunder outside. That cloud is close now.

rain.calm: Everything is quiet. Almost the end of the month.
rain.crack: Your phone falls off the table. Crack!
rain.first1: Oh no. That's what the cloud was carrying.
rain.first2: A flat tyre. Always on a rainy day.
rain.first3: A surprise college fee. Nobody told you.
rain.first4: A cousin's wedding. You need a gift.
rain.first5: Ammamma needs medicine. This can't wait.
rain.cover: Your phone cover helped. Cheaper repair!
rain.payLine: Pick which jar pays. Each choice has a cost.
rain.hint: Add money until the bill is paid.
rain.tejaCard: ₹{{x}} is with Teja. You can't use it.
rain.qcPitch: Need ₹{{x}}? Get it in 30 seconds! No papers!
rain.qcAsk: Guess first: borrow ₹150, pay back how much?
rain.flipNote1: You must pay this on payday.
rain.flipNote2: If you can't pay it all, you still owe the rest.
rain.noFlip: You didn't read the fine print. Always check it.
rain.gLow: You guessed ₹{{g}}. It's ₹{{r}}. ₹{{d}} more than you thought!
rain.gEq: Exactly right! Always read the fine print.
rain.oEmergency: Your emergency money saved the day!
rain.oBetween: Paid from Emergency and Spend. Your goal is safe.
rain.oSave: Paid from Save. The surprise ate into your goal.
rain.oQuick: Done fast. But you pay back ₹{{r}}. That's ₹{{e}} extra.
rain.oMore: Emergency money covered it, with some left over!
rain.first6: Auto drivers are on strike. You need another ride.
rain.first7: A friend is having a birthday. You need a gift.
rain.first8: A bad cold. You need medicine.
rain.again: And the cloud isn't done. One more.
rain.watch: Look up. That cloud is right above us now.
rain.watchS: Whatever it carries is about to land.

tally.settleNone: You don't owe anyone anything. Great!
tally.settleQuick: Payday. Quick Cash takes ₹{{r}}. ₹{{e}} of that is extra.
tally.settleOwed: You still owe ₹{{o}}. It comes out of next month.
tally.clock: That's the month. Let's see how you did.
tally.reached: You reached your goal! Here's how.
tally.reachedCost: Goal reached! But the loan cost ₹{{e}} extra.
tally.notyet: Not this time. Let's see what happened.
tally.secReachedSpent: You spent ₹{{w}} on fun and still hit your goal. Perfect.
tally.secReachedNone: You saved by saying no to everything. That's hard to keep up.
tally.secShortSpent: You had fun, but needed ₹{{x}} more for your goal.
tally.secShortNone: You spent nothing on fun and still fell short. Check the bills.
tally.kind: What kind of money manager are you?
tally.close: Want to try another month? Change one thing.
tally.mm0: Low. A month of mostly no's is tiring. Plan one small treat next time.
tally.mm1: So-so. A bit more room for things you enjoy would help.
tally.mm3: Good. You made room for things that matter to you.
tally.mm4: Great. Treats and friends kept the month fun.
tally.perfectLine: Goal reached, bottles calm, mood good. That is the hardest month to have.

fastmover.name: The Fast Mover
fastmover.line: You acted fast in trouble. Speed cost you extra, but you knew it.

openhand.name: The Kind Friend
openhand.line: You helped your friend first. Kind! Just watch the timing next time.

windowwaiter.name: The Thinker
windowwaiter.line: You waited before buying. Some you kept, some you skipped. Great habit.

quietholder.name: The Saver
quietholder.line: You said no all month. It worked, but you missed out on fun.

shelffirst.name: The Planner
shelffirst.line: You saved first and lived on the rest. That's the smart way.

doorwatcher.name: The Ready One
doorwatcher.line: You kept emergency money. The surprise came, and you were ready.

evenkeeper.name: The Balancer
evenkeeper.line: A bit of everything. Play again to find your style.

cb.flip: You borrowed without reading the fine print. Read it next time.
cb.teja: Teja had your ₹{{l}} when you needed it most.
cb.stayed: You skipped Big Night. Still wanting to go?
cb.brave: No emergency money at the start. The surprise found you.
cb.saidNone: You guessed no surprises. One came anyway.
cb.yusuf: You guessed low on snacks. It was ₹{{x}}.
cb.marble: You spent ₹{{x}} on fun early, so the bottle never popped.
cb.saidOne: You guessed one surprise. You were right!
cb.saidIdk: You said no idea. Now you know: surprises happen.
cb.oneButTwo: You said one surprise. The cloud had two.
cb.saidTwo: You said two or more. You read the cloud well.
cb.twoButOne: You said two or more. It was just one this time.

quick.a: You borrowed ₹{{b}} and paid back ₹{{r}}. That's ₹{{e}} extra, about {{pct}}% in days.
quick.b: Fast loans are expensive. Emergency money costs nothing extra.
quick.c: Before borrowing, check how much you pay back.

covered.a: Your Emergency jar paid ₹{{c}} of the ₹{{b}} bill.
covered.b: With backup money, a surprise is just a small problem, not a debt.
covered.c: Put even ₹20 a month aside for surprises.

notCovered.a: The ₹{{b}} bill came out of your other jars.
notCovered.b: Without backup money, surprises eat your goal or need a loan.
notCovered.c: Next payday, put some money in Emergency first. Even ₹50 helps.

went.a: You kept saying no, then spent big on Big Night.
went.b: Saying no again and again can lead to one big spend. Small treats can be cheaper.
went.c: Plan a small amount each month for something fun.

stayed.a: You stayed home and kept your money. But you still want to go.
stayed.b: Saying no is fine. Just notice when it's getting hard.
stayed.c: Pick one thing you're skipping, and plan when you'll say yes.

none.a: Your bills were ₹80. Your wants were ₹{{w}}.
none.b: Bills must be paid. Wants are a choice. Know the difference.
none.c: List next month's bills first. Plan the rest after.

low.a: Snacks cost ₹{{x}}, more than you guessed.
low.b: Small amounts feel tiny, so we don't count them.
low.c: Pick one daily snack. Add up what it costs in a month.

ok.b: Noticing small spends keeps them small.
ok.c: Ask yourself about one small spend: is it worth it?

dropped.a: You waited on {{m}} things. Skipped {{d}}, saved ₹{{x}}.
dropped.b: Waiting shows if you really want it, or just want it now.
dropped.c: Wait one night before buying anything over ₹100.

still.a: You waited on {{m}} things and still bought {{y}}.
still.b: That's a real choice, not an impulse.
still.c: Keep waiting before you buy. You'll learn what you really want.

never.a: You decided right away every time.
never.b: Sellers say 'today only' so you don't stop and think.
never.c: Next time, wait one night before buying.

lent.a: Teja still had your ₹{{l}} when the surprise came.
lent.b: Lent money isn't yours until it's back. Friends can be late.
lent.c: Only lend what you can live without for a while.

gift.b: A small gift is simple. Nobody has to remember to pay back.
gift.c: If you need it back, give less and call it a gift.

no.b: A kind no protects both your friendship and your money.
no.c: Keep this ready: 'Can't this month. Next chai's on me.'

reached.a: You saved ₹250, spent ₹{{x}} on fun and snacks, and kept ₹{{y}} for emergencies.
reached.b: Money can go many places. A goal helps you choose.
reached.c: Pick your next goal and set a date.

short.b: Other things took your goal money. Knowing what is the first step.
short.c: Find what took the most, and set a limit for it.

big.b: Money you save first is safe from small spends later.
big.c: When you get money, save a fixed amount before spending.

small.b: What you save first, you keep. What's left for later gets spent.
small.c: Decide how much to save before the money comes.

chit.quick: This week: put ₹20 aside for emergencies.
chit.emergency: This week: keep ₹20 somewhere you won't touch.
chit.stayed: This week: pick one thing to skip and one to enjoy.
chit.little: This week: write down every small spend for three days.
chit.cool: This week: wait one night before one unplanned buy.
chit.lend: This week: practise saying 'I can give ₹50.'
chit.goal: This week: write your next goal and a date.

replay.title: One change
replay.ask: New month. What will you do differently?
replay.react: Good. One change at a time. Let's go!
replay.eDoor: More emergency money this time. See how the surprise went.
replay.eFine: You read the fine print. Now you know what loans cost.
replay.eYes: You planned a treat. Check the fun bottle now.
replay.eSurprise: No plan. Let's see what happens!
replay.tejaEpilogue1: Teja said Friday. Friday hasn't come yet.
replay.tejaEpilogue2: Friday came. Teja paid back ₹{{x}} and bought you chai.

gauge.title: How things feel
gauge.why1: Every time you say no to something you want, that bottle gets a bit fizzier. It's not a number to manage. It's just how much you're holding back.
gauge.why2: Say yes to something and it settles. If a bottle gets full it pops, and you get the Big Night.
gauge.why3: The wants bottle is games, clothes and treats. The friends bottle is matches, outings and dinners.
gauge.why4: Mood goes up with treats you chose, time with friends and being kind. It goes down when you say no to everything. It doesn't change your money.
gauge.intro: See the two bottles up top? Every no to a want makes them fizzier. Yes lets them settle.
gauge.tag: Pressure: how much you're holding back
gauge.why5: If a bottle fills up, it pops and you get the Big Night. If your mood ends low, your report says so, and it's a sign to plan a small treat.
gauge.stake: Keep all three stars lit and reach your goal for a Perfect Month.
gauge.risk: A full bottle pops. The Big Night takes ₹60 to ₹100 out of your money.

meet.p1: This is your Wants bottle. Every time you say no to something you want, it gets a little fizzier.
meet.p1s: Games, clothes, treats. Watch the bottle on the table.
meet.p2: And this is your Friends bottle. Matches, outings and dinners fill it the same way.
meet.p2s: Skipping plans with friends builds it up.
meet.p3: Say yes to something and the bottle settles. Say no again and again, and it keeps filling.
meet.p3s: It isn't a number to manage. It's how much you're holding back.
meet.p4: When a bottle is full, it pops.
meet.p4s: That's when the Big Night happens.
meet.p5: And this is your mood. Treats, friends and kindness lift it. A month of only no's wears it down.
meet.p5s: It doesn't change your money. It shows in your report at the end.
meet.p6: Wants cost money too. When Spend runs out, the rest comes out of your goal.
meet.p6s: Bills can't be skipped. Wants can. That's the real choice this month.
meet.p7: Keep both bottles calm and your mood good, and you earn three stars. Three stars and your goal make a Perfect Month.
meet.p7s: That's the real win. Reaching the money alone is only part of it.
meet.p9: The Big Night: everyone is going out and you're asked to join. It costs ₹60 to ₹100.
meet.p9s: Go, go for half, or stay home. Staying home saves money, but the fizz comes with you into next month.
meet.p8: See the cloud outside the window? That's your surprise cloud. It creeps closer every part of the month.
meet.p8s: When it's right above us, a surprise bill lands. Sometimes one, sometimes two. So keep some Emergency money.

letter.body: Here is your money for the month, ₹600. Spend it wisely, and listen to Chacha.
